source: IPR Praha 2023 aerial mesh and 2024 orthophoto, reference only; original clean procedural branches/leaves
limitations: Historical captures differ; cannot infer every present-day tree or botanical species.
Green-point height/PCA can include neighbouring crowns. Parameters guide clean models and do not force photogrammetry defects into the game.
Broadleaf is the default appearance class where a ground-level species reference is unavailable.
Root positions from aerial crown centres have up to 2.5 m uncertainty; roots are grounded in native DMR in the game.

additionalPlacements.note: Broad bare forked trunk in user Street View B6 north entry; sparse silhouette also visible in 2024 orthophoto. Exact trunk not surveyed.
Conical dark evergreen behind the north B6 entry in user Street View; interpreted crown centre on 2024 orthophoto.
Small separated tree crown on the grass directly northwest of B5; 2024 orthophoto.
Separated pointed crown at southwest B6 corner in 2024 orthophoto; appearance class, no botanical species claim.
